dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: I'm just an understudy. I still have a lot to learn.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: It is both my job and my wish to protect and help the weak.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: Stronger people often get the spotlight, but medics should care more for weaker patients.

dialogues.speaker: Golshan
dialogues.text: I believe that the Dendro Archon had the same vision in mind when she led the researchers to build Amurta.
